newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Bomb attack at Honduran power company foiled.
newsitem.headline: Bomb attack at Honduran power company foiled.

text.p: A Honduran bomb squad Wednesday blew up two pounds (0.9 kg) of dynamite that had been planted at the complaint office of the state-owned electric company, police said.
The foiled attack coincided with a government announcement that domestic energy rates would rise 25 percent.

"If it would have exploded at the site where it was placed there would have been a lot of deaths," police spokesman Capt. Danilo Orellana told reporters, adding that the bomb included a timer and a fuse. "The bomb squad arrived just in time.
Two days earlier protesters from poor Tegucigalpa neighbourhoods temporarily trapped 100 government workers in the Economy Ministry building to protest against rising consumer prices.
